The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerkâ€™s Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Councilâ€™s purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speakerâ€™s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak.
During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speakerâ€™s card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Mayor. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Mayor may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Council.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).

RECOMMENDATION:
A.
Overrule protests, if any offered during protest hearing and adopt Resolution 2015-__ confirming the report of costs incurred by the city and authorizing the assessments as liens to be placed on the tax rolls effective September 10, 2015. OR

Amend the charges to be assessed and placed as liens as follows: _________________________________, and adopt Resolution 2015-__.

RECOMMENDATION:
A.
Introduce Ordinance No. 2015- by title only, waive the first reading, and schedule the ordinance for final passage OR
B.
Direct staff to make modifications to the ordinance and bring the modified ordinance back for consideration OR
C.
Receive and file the report.
Staff Report

ORDINANCE NO. 2015-___: AN ORDINANCE OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL AMENDING ARTICLE 10 OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING FILMING HOURS
RECOMMENDATION: Waive first reading of Ordinance No. 2015-__ and schedule the ordinance for final passage.
Staff Report
16.
2015 STATE HOMELAND SECURITY GRANT PROGRAM (SHSGP) GRANT APPLICATION SUBMISSION
RECOMMENDATION:
A.
Receive and file AND/OR
B.
Direct Staff to take the following action ____________________________.
Staff Report
17.
PRE-QUALIFY COMPANIES FOR EMERGENCY ON-CALL SERVICES
RECOMMENDATION:
A.
Find that the contractors who have been successful bidders on roads projects within the last three years (G.M. Sager, R.J. Noble, Surface Constructors, as well as some of the lowest bidders on the 2015 Roads Project) are pre-qualified to perform emergency road and guard rail work for the next 12 months, and authorize staff to establish their interest in performing such services through the solicitation of rate sheets. OR
B.
Direct staff to issue a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to evaluate contractors and pricing in order to create a pre-qualified list of contractors for on-call emergency services.
-------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS --------------------------------
Staff Report
CITY COUNCIL AND STAFF COMMENTS
ADJOURN MEETING
UPON ADJOURNMENT OF THE MEETING, PLEASE LEAVE THE ROOM PROMPTLY AND TAKE YOUR PERSONAL BELONGINGS WITH YOU TO ALLOW STAFF TO CLEAN UP AND CLOSE THE BUILDING. IF YOU ARE RECORDING, PLEASE NOTE THAT THE CONVERSATIONS THAT TAKE PLACE FROM THIS POINT FORWARD MAY BE PRIVATE, ARE NOT PART OF THE PUBLIC MEETING, AND CONSENT OF ALL PARTIES TO THE CONVERSATION MAY BE REQUIRED PRIOR TO RECORDING.
